children: Q3 revenue rose 18.8% year over year to $633.1M, while adjusted EBITDA fell 4.0% to $145.1M. Chemtrade narrowed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $495M–$515M, largely in line with its original guidance.

AI Analyst View
2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance: $495M–$515M
The narrower range provides a firmer full-year earnings outlook; the company says it remains largely in line with its original guidance.
Q3 adjusted EBITDA fell 4.0% to $145.1M
Earnings declined despite higher revenue; chlor-alkali netbacks and sodium chlorate volumes weighed on results.
Q3 revenue rose 18.8% to $633.1M
Growth included Polytec acquisition revenue and higher selling prices; foreign exchange also contributed positively.
Q3 distributable cash: $75.7M vs $77.8M
Cash available after maintenance capex declined year over year, although payout coverage remains a relevant distribution measure.
Net debt was $1.2B; leverage was 2.48x
Leverage was near the company’s target, while the balance sheet remains central to growth and capital allocation plans.
Issued $200M of 5.75% notes due 2032
The post-quarter financing extends debt maturity; proceeds were used to reduce indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a mid-cycle earnings update, with revenue growth offset by lower adjusted EBITDA and segment weakness in chlor-alkali. The next catalysts are Q4 results against the company’s expectation of improvement and the December 7 unitholder vote on the proposed trust-to-corporation conversion.
